slides.title: Winter yard check
slides.sub: 5 things to look at this week

slides.title: Heels and legs
slides.body: After muddy days, check heels and pasterns for scabs or heat.

slides.title: Water
slides.body: Break the ice every morning and evening. Cold water means less drinking.

slides.title: Rugs
slides.body: Slide a hand under the rug at the withers. Warm and dry is right. Sweaty means too heavy.

slides.title: Hay
slides.body: Extra forage helps keep them warm from the inside.

slides.title: Feet
slides.body: Pick out feet daily. Packed mud and stones hide problems.

slides.title: Save this for your next yard visit
slides.question: What's on your winter checklist?
